stories.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson says he intends to stay on as GOP leader even if Republicans lose the majority
stories.summary: Johnson told CBS he would remain the House GOP leader if the party loses its majority in November, while insisting he is confident Republicans will keep or grow it. The comment signals continuity of GOP leadership through a tough midterm cycle.

stories.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
stories.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable models and its first attempt at a frontier model, claiming benchmark scores comparable to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra. Wonder is available through the Meta Model API, while Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers.

stories.title: Nvidia releases Kumo Tabular, an open foundation model for tabular prediction
stories.summary: Nvidia Kumo Tabular predicts labels of new rows in a single forward pass with no training or feature engineering, ranking first on four tabular benchmarks and running far faster than gradient-boosted trees. It could displace the rebuild-from-scratch pattern that has dominated churn, default and demand prediction for two decades.

stories.title: Nvidia and Princeton ReplaySSM speeds hybrid-model decoding
stories.summary: ReplaySSM represent state-space-model state as a checkpoint plus a recent-input buffer, roughly halving state memory traffic and delivering 1.46-1.8x faster decoding kernels and about 2x speculative-decoding throughput on 120B-class models. It is already integrated into TensorRT-LLM, vLLM and FlashInfer.

stories.title: What to know about Patrick Havas, alleged armed figure at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: NBC4 profiled Patrick Havas, the man accused of approaching Democratic governor candidate Amy Acton while armed at a campaign appearance in Mahoning County, including his 2008 arrest record and a donation his brother made in Ohio politics. The incident was condemned by Gov. Mike DeWine, Vivek Ramaswamy and Sen. Jon Husted.

stories.title: Ohio Supreme Court clarifies sex offender registration rules
stories.summary: Ohio high court issued a ruling clarifying how the state sex offender registration rules apply, providing a statewide standard for courts and defendants. The decision affects how registrants and offenses are classified across Ohio.
